assertions.assertion: The patient has a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation and cardiac arrhythmia
The patient reports persistent episodes of palpitations that interfere with daily activities
A 48-hour Holter monitor has been ordered
The service is for continuous ambulatory electrocardiographic recording
The service is medically necessary to document the frequency and timing of the patient's palpitations against the underlying atrial fibrillation and cardiac arrhythmia
